message: I am a pastor today meeting is very blessed
reply: 🎵 🗣️ Praise the LORD our God in the name of Jesus Christ! 🎶
reply: 🙏 All glory to God ❤️✝️🕊️ ! 
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ :
